content: [...] Etwas mehr über die Technik des Blogs steht übrigens bei mir (flyingsparks) und im Update unseres Release-Artikel.     // (c) Script http://www.shauninman.com/js/si.js // Here: Used vor testing only... // Example: http://www.shauninman.com/mentary/past/delete_cookies.php#comments // onkeyup="SI_previewText();" // Zu Beginn schon mal alle aufrufen function SI_previewName() { var d = document; d.getElementById('commentpreviewName').innerHTML = d.getElementById('author').value; d.getElementById('vorschau').style.display = "block"; } function SI_previewHP() { var d = document; d.getElementById('commentpreviewURI').innerHTML = d.getElementById('url').value; d.getElementById('vorschau').style.display = "block"; } function SI_previewText() { var d = document; d.getElementById('commentpreviewText').innerHTML = SI_markdownWithSmartyPants(d.getElementById('comment').value); d.getElementById('vorschau').style.display = "block"; } function SI_markdownWithSmartyPants(txt) { // ` :: code txt = txt.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,''+'$1'+''); // Need to remove and protect this code block from the other replacements // & :: & txt = txt.replace(/&/g,'&'); txt = txt.replace(/&(amp;)+/g,'&'); // --- :: en dash txt = txt.replace(/-{3}/g, '–'); // -- :: em dash txt = txt.replace(/-{2}/g,'—'); // ... :: ellipsis txt = txt.replace(/.{3}/g,'…'); // " :: to smart quotes txt = txt.replace(/"(.*[^"])"/g,'“$1”'); // **|__ :: strong txt = txt.replace(/(*|_){2}([^*_]+)(*|_){2}/g,''+'$2'+''); // *|_ :: em txt = txt.replace(/(*|_)([^*_]+)(*|_)/g,''+'$2'+''); // paragraph breaks txt = ''+txt.replace(/(rn|n)/g,'').replace(/(){2,}/gi,'')+'' return txt; } [...]
